name: Biến đổi trước và sau
learningGoal: The viewer can describe the start, the trigger conditions, the intermediate steps and the end state, and when the change does not happen.
topics: Hạt đậu khô thành cây đậu non
Từ ngại nói đến dám chào bằng tiếng Anh
Đá thành nước rồi thành hơi
Một khoản để dành nhỏ lớn dần theo thời gian
Từ viết chữ nguệch ngoạc đến viết chữ đều

stages.label: Ban đầu
stages.purpose: Show the starting state clearly enough that the change will be obvious later.
stages.layout: Before/after track: the subject centred at x 540 in the band 420-1050, a progress bar with stage labels in 1080-1200 inside x 70-1010, the trigger tag in 322-400. Progress marker at the start; the bar is a qualitative stage track, never a measured percentage.
stages.motion: The subject is on screen at the cut and barely moves; only ambient background life moves.
stages.ending: End on the unchanged starting state.

stages.label: Tác nhân
stages.purpose: Name what starts the change, stated as conditions, not as a guarantee.
stages.layout: Subject keeps its centre and size. The trigger items (water, warmth) appear around it; the trigger tag updates.
stages.motion: Each trigger item arrives on the word that names it; the progress marker moves only a little.
stages.ending: End with the conditions in place and the change just beginning.

stages.label: Thay đổi
stages.purpose: Show the change as a sequence of visible steps in their real order.
stages.layout: Same subject slot; it morphs step by step. The progress label of the current step lights; earlier labels stay lit.
stages.motion: Each step happens on the word that names it; progress advances with each spoken step, never jumping to the end.
stages.ending: End mid-way: the subject has clearly changed but is not finished.

stages.label: Kết quả
stages.purpose: Show the end state next to a reminder of the start, with honest qualifiers on time and conditions.
stages.layout: End state in the subject slot; a small 'before' thumbnail sits at the left of the progress bar for comparison. Progress marker at the end.
stages.motion: The final step completes on the result word; the before thumbnail pops in on the comparison word.

stages.label: Ý nghĩa
stages.purpose: Say what the transformation teaches, including when it does not happen, and suggest a safe way to see it yourself.
stages.layout: Before and after both visible; the trigger tag states the condition-based takeaway.
stages.motion: The takeaway writes on; the after state gives one small idle motion (a leaf sway).
stages.ending: Close on a small safe experiment or practice the viewer can try. No product pitch.

reviewQuestions: Are the intermediate steps in their real order and shown, not skipped?
Are time and outcome claims qualified (often, may, depending on temperature) and free of invented numbers?
Is the trigger described as conditions rather than a guarantee?
Do before and after stay comparable on screen at the result stage?
Is the suggested try-it-yourself activity safe for the audience?

sources.title: OpenStax Biology 2e, 32.2 Pollination and Fertilization: Seed Germination
sources.scope: Sample biology: seed dormancy, environmental germination conditions, radicle/root development and stored food reserves supporting the seedling. The animation is schematic, not a measured growth timeline.

sources.title: Tversky, Morrison & Betrancourt 2002, Animation: can it facilitate? (International Journal of Human-Computer Studies)
sources.scope: Design guidance: show perceptible intermediate states and stable references; animation is not automatically better than information-equivalent static diagrams.

sources.title: Brame 2016, Effective Educational Videos: Principles and Guidelines for Maximizing Student Learning from Video Content (CBE Life Sciences Education)
sources.scope: Signaling, segmenting and weeding extraneous detail in instructional video; it gives no evidence for fixed cut lengths or an optimal total duration.

lines.text: Một hạt đậu khô có thể nằm yên trong túi rất lâu mà không thay đổi.
Rồi ta đặt hạt lên bông ẩm, ở nơi đủ ấm và có không khí.
Nước, độ ấm và không khí giúp hạt đậu bắt đầu nảy mầm.
Đầu tiên, hạt hút nước và phồng to lên, vỏ hạt bắt đầu nứt.
Sau đó, một chiếc rễ nhỏ nhú ra và mọc hướng xuống dưới.
Tiếp theo, một thân mầm nhỏ vươn lên phía trên.
Sau vài ngày, tùy nhiệt độ, hạt khô đã thành một cây đậu non có lá đầu tiên.
Thời gian thôi là chưa đủ, hạt đậu cần đúng điều kiện để bắt đầu thay đổi.
Nếu thiếu nước hoặc quá lạnh, hạt có thể nằm yên rất lâu.
Bạn có thể tự thử với vài hạt đậu xanh và một miếng bông ẩm.
